If a distinct loop1-scope pseudo (e.g. a diagnostic-counter accumulator over player-relative bytes at 0x18-0x1A range) contributes those same neighbors WITHOUT fusing with `b` at the source level, it might reproduce the flip without the dead-store or RA-cascade objections.
